result: No remaining concrete fail-open or lifecycle blocker found in the final frozen revision.
scope: Independent read-only source and original-byte review. No test, Android, emulator, APK, installation, monitoring session or source/Git mutation was performed by this reviewer.

resolved_findings.finding: Original parent start timestamp was captured after Popen and could follow the child wait command under delayed parent scheduling.
resolved_findings.final_contract: UTC start is now captured immediately before Popen, while the strict chronological coverage check remains unchanged.

resolved_findings.finding: Actual successful ADB startup can produce the original 77 bytes on wait-for-device stderr.
resolved_findings.final_contract: Only exact empty or exact original success bytes are accepted; successful wait RC remains required and monitor/logcat/endpoint stderr remain strict. No line normalization or generic stderr filtering.

checked_guards: begin binds the existing live PID/start-ticks monitor, original positive readiness, same adb/serial and untouched identity bytes before the workflow installation boundary.

finish takes five bounded read-only endpoint command records before requesting stop of that same monitor, then verifies retained originals offline. It does not clear buffers, restart monitoring or dismiss dialogs.

One unfiltered all-buffer threadtime session must run through the complete endpoint interval; requested stop, no budget exhaustion, exact command set, original file hashes, unchanged source identity and nonempty complete output are mandatory.
Exact original am_anr and ActivityManager ANR records, unknown-prefix ANR markers, final Window error history and InputDispatcher last-ANR history remain terminal even after an earlier guard PASS.
Endpoint dump commands, success/time bounds, file inventory, actual positive current dispatch state, Android37/17/fingerprint/system_server PID/start count and successful tour exit must remain bound.

Existing readiness timeout, stability, secure/unknown-state and unlock behavior are unchanged; the new explicit 1..7200-second monitor duration preserves the old default450 and does not extend or restart a failed session.

tests.owner_scope: Synthetic/offline contracts and one explicitly synthetic local adb subprocess; no new real device acceptance.

limits: Existing actual Host7b16 API37 GMS broadcast ANR remains a failed original run.
The final real diagnostic workflow must call begin before installation and finish before emulator teardown; that workflow is owned/reviewed by Root.
This verifies bounded recorded ANR evidence, not APK functionality, FPS, future stability or a real emulator success.
Prior frozen parser and intermediate ANR packs remain unchanged and are not relabeled as this revision.
